INSERT INTO blocked_ips (ip, failed_count, last_failure)
         VALUES (?, 1, datetime('now'))
         ON CONFLICT(ip) DO UPDATE SET
             failed_count = failed_count + 1,
             last_failure = datetime('now'),
             blocked_at   = CASE
                 WHEN blocked_at IS NULL AND failed_count + 1 >= ?
                 THEN datetime('now')
                 ELSE blocked_at
             END
